scope: 600 ticks of complete helper-observable JSON equality; this is not a complete stepGame proof or a performance benchmark.
baselineProvenance: The five frozen helper files match f33904e byte-for-byte. The surrounding copied tree is not represented as a pure baseline commit; the local runtime import closure has only these five differing files.

commonDependencies.method: Static local runtime import closure from the seven helper/deck/geometry entries, excluding type-only imports; sorted compact JSON of path-to-SHA256 values.

comparedFields: units (all serialized fields, including orders, crew cabin/deck state, sailing routes and planner tickets)

fixture.map: bareDuel metadata; 4096 x 4096; 128 x 128 all-water cells of size32

events.operation: Crew leaves cabin and receives a board order for the other transport.
Every existing ship dies; both sides retain their units array.
Ships regain HP and each helper frame is rebuilt.
Append a live transport to the same array.
Replace the unit arrays through JSON serialization/restore; move the dock input300 units.
Remove the second transport by replacing each unit array.

fixture.eachTick: Begin motion/collision and planning frames; prepare crew and defense; request planner grants; two yaw/surge movement requests per moving hull; sync decks; settle crossings; direct ground constraint; count and drain collision impacts. Identical serialized results are asserted before updating the observable hash.

coverageLimits: This fixture observes one physical impact and 20 frames with all ships dead. It does not itself create ground clipping; groundClips is0.
Dock input is changed symmetrically, but dock geometry is not part of the serialized map and no separate dock impact is claimed.

Pure-helper early-return laziness, equal-length replacement, orphan cleanup, shoreline/ground-body/dock/obstacle contact and first boarding/transfer rely on the existing regression cases below, rather than a claim that this600-tick fixture exercises each one.
No frame duration, test threshold, original assertion, navigation resolution or physical check is weakened by this proof.

src/shared/ship-collisions.test.ts: keeps collision-frame velocity lazy after ignoring a deck crew / ship / deep-water walker ground step (three variants; actual later closing speed32)
clears undrained impacts when the last hull dies and rebuilds current dock geometry when it returns
keeps an empty frame separate from another game with undrained impacts and admits a newly added hull
rebuilds a direct helper frame after an equal-length member replacement
clips ground walking continuously at a hull without putting the soldier aboard
blocks a dock foundation and destructible obstacle using their real footprints
records a damaging shoreline impact and keeps gentle blocked coast contact quiet
src/shared/ship-motion.test.ts: replenishes the retained yaw, travel and astern budgets only at the next frame
src/shared/boarding-control.test.ts: cleans an abandoned implicit approach even when the surviving list has no hulls
finishes a large-to-small crew transfer and its saved continuation identically

reproduction.note: Only module/result paths and erased TypeScript fixture types differ in the portable harness. The executed fixture statements, tick count, assertions and JSON hash formula are unchanged. Create two checkouts of testedFinalSourceCommit; replace the five listed files in the before checkout with baselineHelpersCommit versions. Save portableHarnessSource as compare-helpers.mts, then use the Node20 tsx loader with finalRoot beforeRoot outputJson as its three positional arguments.
